1. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprised of an at least substantially hollow columnar body, a plurality of light emitting diodes disposed on said columnar body, a plurality of fins disposed on said columnar body, a base member disposed at a first end of the columnar body and providing a means for electrical connection, and an electronics module disposed within the columnar body and in electrical communication with the base member, __wherein said columnar body comprises a material having a thermal conductivity greater than 200 W/mK__.

2. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein a second end of said columnar body is open __and said fins extend radially outward from said columnar body at angles between 30 and 60 degrees from the columnar body surface__.

3. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 further including a light dispersing optic element overlapping said diodes, __wherein said optic element is positioned to direct light at an angle of at least 45 degrees from the elongated axis of the columnar body__.

4. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element includes a phosphor material __and is integrally formed with a lens structure__.

5. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said diodes are substantially evenly spaced radially around the columnar body.

6. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 5 wherein said fins are substantially equally disposed between said diodes __and each fin is positioned at a radial distance from the columnar body axis that is greater than the radial distance of the diodes__.

7. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body comprises one of a tetragon, pentagon, hexagon, heptagon, octagon, nonagon, decagon, hendecagon, or dodecagon in cross-section.

8. (Original) The lamp of claim 7 wherein at least one diode resides on each face of said columnar body.

9. (Original) The lamp of claim 8 wherein one fin resides on each corner of said columnar body.

10. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 wherein a single diode resides on each face __and said single diode is positioned at the center of each face__.

11. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said columnar body and said fins are comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK.

12. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 9 including __a plurality of optic elements, with a single optic element disposed between each adjacent fin overlapping said diode, wherein each optic element is independently removable__.

13. (Original) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said base member comprises an Edison screw base or a wedge base.

14. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 1 wherein said electronics module comprises a printed circuit board including circuitry for converting AC to DC current __and further includes a voltage regulator for stabilizing output voltage to said light emitting diodes__.

15. (Currently Amended) The lamp of claim 3 wherein said optic element preferentially directs light substantially perpendicular to an elongated axis of the columnar body __and includes a diffusing surface with a surface roughness of at least 0.5 micrometers__.

16. (Currently Amended) A lamp comprising an elongated hollow polygonal body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, a fin extending radially from each corner of said body __at an angle of at least 45 degrees from the body surface__, a light emitting diode mounted to each side of said body __at the center of each side__, a screw or wedge base connector closing a first end of said body, a second end of said body being open, an electronics module disposed within said body in electrical communication with said connector and said light emitting diodes, said lamp having a general A19 outline.

17. (Currently Amended) A method of manufacturing a lamp comprising extruding an elongated hollow body, said body comprised of a material having a thermal conductivity greater than __200__ W/mK, cutting said body to a predetermined length, attaching at least one light emitting diode to said body __at the center of each side face__, and providing electrical circuitry suitable for powering said light emitting diode __with voltage regulation__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein said material has a thermal conductivity greater than about __250__ W/mK.

19. (Original) The method of claim 17 wherein said body includes a plurality of integral radially extending fins.

20. (Cancelled)
